summary: Email marketing legacy powerhouse — huge SMB user base, but modern developer email APIs are taking new builders.
moat: Mailchimp's moat is massive legacy distribution: acquired by Intuit for $12B, it serves millions of small businesses with all-in-one email deliverability, IP reputation, and CRM sync. Its marketing automation and template builder are well understood by non-technical marketing staff. However, new startups and indie vibe-coders overwhelmingly choose developer-first email platforms like Resend and Loops that offer superior DX and lower pricing.

challengers.name: Resend, Loops, and AI-powered newsletter engines
challengers.evidence: Resend reached over 100,000 developers in its first 18 months with React Email and modern API primitives, capturing the next generation of software products away from Mailchimp.
